Today, I am going to show you the new features of Marvelous Designer. ## Interface Changes In Marvelous Designer 11, we have a new feature: a bug. There are some changes in the interface layout. One is "General," which is the basic one, containing the library window, 3D and 2D windows, and also a Store. Marvelous Designer has built a business city on the official website where you can see videos and buy clothes according to your needs. We will talk more about the store update later. ### Work Area Windows In the current interface layout, we now have a systematic name for this window. These two in the middle are called work area windows. The work area window does not have the function of closing, only the function of copying. Other windows on the left and right will have functions such as folding and closing. ## Working Areas Now we have two main working areas. In the lower right corner, we can switch the number of main working areas. By default, we have two main working areas and can switch to three working areas. After switching, we can view different 3D windows from various angles. ### Editing in 3D and 2D Windows When we have multiple 3D windows, we can choose from the main window. For example, if I click on the 3D window on the left, our 2D window will be selected in the same way. This is similar to the previous version. When I choose a tool, such as a sewing tool, I can click on the sewing tool and then click on the clothes. ## New Features Overview Let's take a look at some new features: 1. **Multiple 3D Windows**: When editing in the 3D window, we can also edit in the 2D window simultaneously. 2. **Multiple Window Arrangement**: Now, we can place up to four main windows. However, there can only be one 2D window in your main work area interface. 3. **Window Management**: When copying a window, it will appear as a pop-up window in our interface, allowing for better organization and arrangement. ## Animation Editor Now, let's discuss the animation editor. In the animation editor, some functions from the old version have been integrated. For example, it now includes input and playback options, as well as settings for animation playback. ### Animation Playback Settings In Marvelous Designer 11, we will only record the animation in the play area you set. This means the start frame will dictate where the recording begins. You can set the play area, the start frame, and the end frame. ## Store Update In the new version, we built a shop on the Marvelous Designer website. You don't need to open a shop on the website; you can use it to buy and check some products. To log in, you will use the account and password from the Marvelous Designer website, not the software. ### Shopping Process After logging in, you can see various products sold in our shop interface. You can click on a product to see its details, add it to your shopping cart, and make purchases. The products can include free clothing items, which you can download and use. ## Smart Top Feature Marvelous Designer 11 introduces a feature called "Smart Top." This tool allows for the easy creation of tops with detailed adjustments. ### Creating a Top To create a top, you must draw a closed shape, which can be a triangle or a square. The tool will create an inner elliptic line based on the closed shape you made. ## Conclusion Thank you for your attention.
